people.name: Eliashib
people.line: High priest, father of Joiada and ancestor of Jaddua

people.name: Horonites
people.line: A people group opposed to Nehemiah's work.

people.name: Joiada
people.line: A high priest, son of Eliashib

people.name: Sanballat
people.line: Governor of Samaria, opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem

people.name: daughter_of_Sanballat
people.line: Married to a grandson of the high priest Eliashib

people.name: son_of_Joiada
people.line: Grandson of Eliashib, married Sanballat's daughter

translations.web: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.
translations.bsb: Even one of the sons of Jehoiada son of Eliashib the high priest had become a son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. Therefore I drove him away from me.
